deviations_from_card: (1) Scope follows critic_revise and the orchestrator: no jobs.ts, no work.ts, no separate job field, no second runner; A's jobs record and runJob() carry it. Cases 1, 3, 4, 5 and 7 are A's. Case 7 in A's test was extended with one assertion: a saved running job keeps its input after the restart, so Try again is still offered. (2) The suite is tools/desk-jobs-rules-test.cjs, extended in place. There is no tools/session-rules-test.cjs and desk/package.json is unchanged. (3) 'Held input' is a new optional Job.input (a JobInput record of strings and numbers), set through a new runJob option, `input`. read holds {id}; the image stays on the session's page and is not copied into the job. hint holds {itemIx, askedQ, stage?}. practice holds {topic}. Only read, hint and practice can be retried. Any other kind, or a kind with nothing failed, answers 409 NOTHING. (4) The retry route re-posts the held input to the kind's own route POST, so a retry is the same job with the same 409, 502 and late-drop rules. /api/read now also accepts {id} alone, meaning read again a page the desk already holds, with the same id; an unknown id answers 409. A hint retry answers 409 MOVED_ON when the current page's item at the held index no longer has the job's key. (5) Case 6 is enforced twice. The practice work checks run.current() and that the learner id is unchanged before practice.set. The reducer also drops a running practice job whenever the learner changes (learner.set or profile.save), so the late run is superseded, not recorded as done or failed. The route then answers 409 MOVED_ON and clears its own 'writing a practice set…' line. (6) The card labelled case 8 a GUARD, but its 403 half was red before, because POST /api/session accepted job.*. It is split into a GUARD (a successful read gives the same items and status line, green before) and a red case 8 (the job.* 403). Case 9 is the added policy-tighten case. (7) The TV is untouched. A already shows failed jobs and retries a failed topic on Select. (8) No Playwright or phone capture was run, because the worktree cannot run next dev (@next/env missing, as reported by earlier waves). The phone change is covered by tsc only.
notes: POLICY-TIGHTEN, SERVER-ONLY EVENTS: POST /api/session now answers 403 with a desk sentence to linga.changed (as before), job.start, job.done, job.failed, practice.set, practice.marked, practice.settle, page.reading, page.read, hint.set, hint.stage, english.set, essay.set, and a lesson.set that carries a key (the hint's pick). A keyless lesson.set, the TV's unit and calendar picks, still passes. The list is SERVER_ONLY in desk/src/app/api/session/route.ts. It was built by grepping every client poster: tv/keys.ts, app/tv/page.tsx, app/phone/page.tsx, english/*.tsx, uat/driver and tools/linga-ui-test.cjs. None of them posts a refused event; case 9 asserts that nav, item, status, keyless lesson.set, timer.start and walk still answer 200. Not refused, because clients post them: timer.tick (the TV page posts it, and so does the server ticker), status, and the other navigation, profile and task events. EXPORTS: store.ts adds type JobInput = Record<string, string|number>, Job.input?, and job.start's input?. job.ts adds JobOptions.input, MOVED_ON ('The desk has moved on since that was asked.') and NOTHING ('There is nothing to try again.'). New route: POST /api/session/retry {kind: 'read'|'hint'|'practice'} proxies to the kind's route and returns that route's answer (200, 409 or 502). PHONE: failed(kind) offers Try again only for a failed job that has input and has not been stepped past. Capture shows the read's sentence plus Try again and 'Snap a new page'. Point & ask shows a failed hint on the item the TV is on. Practice (no set yet) shows a failed practice set. A 502 from /api/read or /api/hint no longer repeats the sentence in the status line; the retry block shows it. KNOWN GAPS: a failed read still leaves A's empty page (items [], provider 'error') on the desk until it is retried. Snapping a new page instead leaves that empty page behind. mark, explain, analyse and memory are not retryable in place, because their input is an image or free text too big or too private to hold on the job.
